expected.canonical_headline: Fatal Medical Call on Florida's Turnpike Near Fort Pierce Leaves One Dead
expected.canonical_permalink_origin_headline: Fatal Medical Call on Florida's Turnpike Near Fort Pierce Leaves One Dead
selected_headlines: Man dies after medical distress at Fort Pierce Service Plaza on Florida's Turnpike
source_headlines: Fatal incident reported on Florida’s Turnpike near Fort Pierce Service Plaza - WPBF
novel_facts: FHP reports that no foul play is suspected and that the man's traveling companions said he had been feeling unwell.
FHP found the man unresponsive, not breathing and without a pulse at 5:40 a.m.
The man was transported to Florida Coast Medical Center and pronounced dead at the hospital.
